description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Sharuum targeting Technomancer.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
